fields.label: Shopify Connection
fields.description: The Shopify store this row belongs to. Shopify ids are only unique within one store, so every lookup pairs the id with this field -- without it a second store's product 12345 finds the first store's row. Set by the connector; never hand-edited.

fields.label: Tag
fields.description: Not unique -- two stores can each have their own 'Sale' tag. The row's name is namespaced per store (see shopify/product/tags.py's tag_doc_name), except the default connection's, which stays the bare tag name for backward compatibility.
